use default

reorder(items: string[], order: string[]) -> string[] is
    let wanted = MAP()

    for item in order do
        let already mut = 0

        wanted.try_get_value(item, already ref)
        wanted[item] = already + 1
    od

    let places = LIST()

    for entry in items |> index() do
        let outstanding mut = 0

        wanted.try_get_value(entry.value, outstanding ref)

        if outstanding > 0 then
            wanted[entry.value] = outstanding - 1

            places.add(entry.index)
        fi
    od

    let reordered = LIST(items)

    for place in places |> index() do
        reordered[place.value] = order[place.index]
    od

    reordered.to_array()
